name: Full Bleed Gradient Manifesto
tagline: Orange-to-crimson-to-magenta gradient with white Anton condensed capitals and thin white rules. (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: 118-degree gradient from orange through red to magenta, all type in white

typography.style: tall condensed capitals over a full-bleed gradient with Archivo captions

best_for: Promises, manifestos and one-sentence positions for arts, events and brands. The gradient carries the mood so type can stay stark.
avoid_for: Tables, charts or long explanatory text.
